text:
maya: Quick 'mug round the world' thread! post your coziest mug pic, timezone, and favorite tiny holiday treat. i'll compile them for a mini collage. :camera_with_flash: :mug: 

jared: NYC EST 1: peppermint hot chocolate. (uploads pic) cat refused to cooperate. :cat:

li: SGP SGT 1: bah humbug instant coffee but i have a glitter penguin mug. ginger snap for me.

sophia: CEST 1: baking shortbread tonight, will bring to SF shelf if anyone's local. also down for a 15-min mugs-up micro-call. :sparkles:

noah: PST (SEA) 1: camping mug = tiny but battle-scarred. marshmallow stan. :marshmallow:

maya: vote time! react with :one: for ginger snap, :two: for marshmallow, :three: for shortbread. i'll keep the tally open till 6pm UTC.

ops-bot: Reminder: if you're dropping food in the SF kitchen, label allergens. (posted by @ops)

jared: :one: shortbread looks dangerously popular already.

li: (uploads image) penguin + airport coffee. 

sophia: (uploads image) shortbread test batch. very crumbly, will improve. :yum:

maya: Love the pics. who can join a timezone-friendly mugs-up at 5pm UTC? react with :raised_hands: and i'll DM a link.

noah: :raised_hands: i'll be there, mugs ready.

jared: :raised_hands: counted.

maya: tally so far: ginger snap (3), marshmallow (2), shortbread (4). shortbread takes it! i'll pin the collage after i collect images.

ops-bot: FYI: SF office ambient playlist updated with holiday tunes. (link posted)

sophia: i'll add recipe notes to the #holiday-photos thread afterwards. thanks for the collab, team.

maya: final note 1: if anyone wants a printed 4x6 of their mug for desks, react with :frame_with_picture: and i'll organize a small run.

li: :frame_with_picture: please.

noah: see you all at 5pm UTC for a blink-and-toast! :clinking_glasses:
